description: Android Fragment class managing Wi-Fi Direct device interactions, including connection setup, data transfer, and file server/client operations.

classes.name: DeviceDetailFragment
classes.description: Fragment managing Wi-Fi Direct device details, connection, and data transfer.

classes.name: FileServerAsyncTask
classes.description: AsyncTask implementing a simple server socket to receive files over Wi-Fi Direct.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the device detail layout and sets up button click handlers for connect, disconnect, and start client actions.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from file picker intent, initiates file transfer service.

methods.name: onConnectionInfoAvailable
methods.description: Handles Wi-Fi P2P connection info, updates UI, and starts server if group owner.

methods.name: showDetails
methods.description: Displays device information in the UI.
